learn.title: Learn the Gates
learn.intro: Every logic gate takes 0s and 1s in and gives one 0 or 1 out. Flip the switches to see how each gate behaves.

gates.NOT: The output is the opposite of the input.
gates.AND: The output is 1 only when ALL inputs are 1.
gates.OR: The output is 1 when AT LEAST ONE input is 1.
gates.NAND: NOT AND: the output is 0 only when all inputs are 1.
gates.NOR: NOT OR: the output is 1 only when all inputs are 0.
gates.XOR: Exclusive OR: the output is 1 when the inputs are different.
